source_row.extraction_instructions: /events/page/N/ (rel=next); cards .card__preview with .subheading, .h5 title, .date, .venue; detail header 'D-D Month, YYYY | City, Country' + Fees tab (label/amount lines).

registry_comment: European Respiratory Society - WordPress generic family (constants only)

spot_check.site_says: ERS members EUR 1,000; Non-ERS members EUR 1,100
19 November, 2026 | Online; Fees: Free for ERS members and non-members

concerns: Platform: WordPress (custom theme, Yoast). Subclass = 1 regex constant, 0 lines of parsing code.

Listing: /events/ ?page walk via pagination-next; the site's '48 pages' is a WP artifact - only pages 1-3 hold cards, the walk stops after 2 pages with nothing new. 29 upcoming events found (expected ~48 in recon was the all-time sitemap count). Cards also link to channel.ersnet.org (/event-NNN conferences, /media-NNN webinars); those are included via EVENT_LINK_RE, which is why the base accepts same-site subdomains.

venue_name is 0/5: ERS puts the venue address in an unlabelled Venue tab panel after the fee panel; the family reads only the 'Heidelberg, Germany' header/card line, so city+country are set but not the venue building. A ~10-line hook (venue panel) would fix it - this is the one place ERS would need bespoke code.

Undated cards (EBUS part 3, sleep programme parts, e-learning) cost one page load each at listing time and are dropped when the page shows no date; capped at 30 per run. Two e-learning cards carry a placeholder date in 2030/2031 and are dropped by MAX_FUTURE_DAYS (1100).

Channel conference pages (event-NNN) put the real fee on my.ersnet.org or a /hp-NNN-registration sub-page; harness PRICE_EXTERNAL_LINK (ERS Satellites) fired - needs the shared explorer to follow. Webinar pages include 'Fees: Free ...' and become a EUR 0 tier.
Channel pages are Vimeo/CDN heavy; description is filtered for 'CDN connection issue' / login boilerplate but a few webinar pages have no real prose (description None).
Registration needed in extractors/__init__.py (not touched): import the class and add it to EXTRACTOR_REGISTRY under the new source id. wordpress_generic.py itself needs no registration.

Coverage checklist: (1) multi-day ranges: listing date-range parser plus header-zone range on the detail page, both unit-tested; (2/4/5) fees on external or same-site registration pages are NOT followed by the family - left to remediator.explorer (PLAYBOOK says it handles them); the harness PRICE_*_LINK warnings below are those cases; (3) image fee tables not checked here (no site showed one); (6/7) call-for-papers deadlines left to the merge step per PLAYBOOK (extract_abstract_info is deliberately not called), harness SUBMISSION_NO_DEADLINE warnings are that step's job; (8) CTA text: no tier labels come from link text; (9) location on page: header-line / labelled-line / JSON-LD parsing, harness LOCATION_ON_PAGE never fired.
No JSON-LD Event exists on any trial site (checked all five listing and detail pages), so the JSON-LD offers path is covered by offline fixtures only, not by a live page.

WP REST path (REST_POST_TYPE) is implemented and unit-tested offline but OFF by default and unproven live: /wp-json/wp/v2/events (ERS) and /wp/v2/event (BCIS) exist but return acf=[] and no event dates (the core 'date' is the publish date); BSGE exposes no events post type. HTML cards are the only date source on these sites.
with_venue in probe_results counts venue_name OR city (both are location evidence); venue_name alone is lower and noted per site.
